nodes.label: Notification deep links with nonce verification
nodes.norm_label: notification deep links with nonce verification
nodes.rationale: ?d=DATE&r=SLOT&n=NONCE; verifyNonce yields ok/bad/unknown shown as Aviso check/warn/?

nodes.label: Reminder events (10:00 / 16:30, 21-day horizon)
nodes.rationale: Two timed events per eligible weekday with random nonce and deep link; deleted when the day is marked

nodes.label: PWA App Icon 512x512
nodes.description: Flat minimalist icon: crimson red office building with gold roof band, 3x3 grid of gold windows and a dark doorway, centered on a near-black navy background.

nodes.label: Brand Palette (Crimson, Gold, Dark Navy)
nodes.rationale: Dark background with high-contrast crimson/gold suggests a dark-themed app UI; likely matches manifest theme/background colors.

nodes.label: Office Building Symbol
nodes.rationale: Building glyph visually communicates the app's purpose of tracking office visits/attendance.

nodes.label: Audit log (source, timestamp, change id, device id)
nodes.norm_label: audit log (source, timestamp, change id, device id)
nodes.rationale: Last 10 entries per day written into the Calendar event description for cross-device review

nodes.label: Change flow with 5s undo window
nodes.rationale: Pushes wait UNDO_MS so the undo toast can cancel; flushed immediately when page is hidden

nodes.label: Festivos Colombia (automatic holidays)
nodes.rationale: Fixed, Ley Emiliani and Semana Santa holidays computed for any year

nodes.label: Monthly quota logic (8 - adjusted weeks)
nodes.rationale: Weeks with a holiday or vacation have quota 1 instead of 2; straddling weeks count only days in the visible month so no day counts twice

nodes.label: Google Cloud OAuth 2.0 Client ID setup
nodes.norm_label: google cloud oauth 2.0 client id setup
nodes.rationale: User supplies own Client ID; app origin must be in Authorized JavaScript origins

nodes.label: Legacy v2 event cleanup from primary calendar
nodes.norm_label: legacy v2 event cleanup from primary calendar
nodes.rationale: Separate one-time permission requested only for the cleanup

nodes.label: Secondary Office Tracker calendar
nodes.rationale: Primary calendar untouched; can be hidden without affecting the app

nodes.label: OAuth scope calendar.app.created
nodes.rationale: Least privilege: access only to calendars this app creates; calendar.events requested solely for cleanupLegacy

nodes.label: Global state object S (localStorage ot-data-v2, schema v3)
nodes.norm_label: global state object s (localstorage ot-data-v2, schema v3)
nodes.rationale: One global object holds everything; load() migrates older shapes by marking days pending and moving old event ids to legacy

nodes.label: Two-way Google Calendar sync
nodes.rationale: Pending local changes win, otherwise Calendar wins; duplicate same-day events deleted; classify() maps titles to office/vacation

nodes.label: Serialized Calendar API queue (enqueue)
nodes.rationale: All Calendar API calls go through a single promise chain to avoid concurrent conflicting writes; keep new API work inside enqueue

nodes.label: Sync conflict rule (phone wins if pending, else Calendar)
nodes.norm_label: sync conflict rule (phone wins if pending, else calendar)

nodes.label: Office Tracker PWA
nodes.rationale: Single-page Spanish-UI PWA, no build step; all code in index.html, deployed as static files on GitHub Pages

nodes.label: Android install via Chrome Add to home screen
nodes.norm_label: android install via chrome add to home screen

nodes.label: Service worker VERSION bump on publish
nodes.norm_label: service worker version bump on publish
nodes.rationale: Bump VERSION in sw.js so old caches drop; HTML network-first, icons/manifest cache-first, Google origins bypass SW
